source: SBP EasyData API <https://easydata.sbp.org.pk/api/v1/series/<series_key>/{meta,data}>, dataset 'Structure of Interest Rate: T-Bills Auction Result' (TS_GP_BAM_SIRTBIL_AH), series TS_GP_BAM_SIRTBIL_AH.TB0010, TS_GP_BAM_SIRTBIL_AH.TB0020, TS_GP_BAM_SIRTBIL_AH.TB0030, TS_GP_BAM_SIRTBIL_AH.TB0040, TS_GP_BAM_SIRTBIL_AH.TB0050, TS_GP_BAM_SIRTBIL_AH.TB0060
notes: SBP EasyData API, T-bill auction results, one row per series per auction date (long format; tenor_months and yield_type identify the series). Re-queryable, but SBP may revise or remove data without notice, so each run's raw responses are kept as the record of what we saw (append_only_snapshot); revisions against the previous run are logged as warnings. Rows SBP marks 'Missing value' are kept with value null and is_missing true. Series names have a leading '. ' removed in processed; interim keeps them as returned. published_at = auction date 23:59:59 Asia/Karachi in UTC (basis auction_date_end_of_day_pkt), checked on 2026 auctions only. Gaps of more than 21 days between auctions are listed in extra.gaps. 1-month bills are not in this dataset.
